none: PAS KENT-98F626: KENT-98F626. Roman coin: Barbarous radiate of Tetricus I (reverse)
contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

Contemporary copy of a Roman Radiate. This barbarous radiate dates from 271-274AD and is of Tetricus I. The coin was struck in copper alloy and has a light green patina. There is a right facing radiate bust on the obverse with the partial legend IMP TET. The reverse is very worn and depicts Pax with the legend PA[X] AVG. The coin measures 16.72mm in diameter, is 1.4mm thick and weighs 1.05 grams
